ns2:section.sectionText: This course supports LAS students engaged in part-time internship experiences during an academic semester. Students are provided with career development resources to help make the most of their hands-on experiences. Students set and monitor professional goals, engage in active reflection on progress, and consider next steps for academic and career futures. One virtual meeting is required at the beginning of the semester; remaining materials and activities are asynchronous via Canvas. S/U grading only. Course may be repeated. Instructor approval required. Restricted to students in the college of LAS.
